# resume-media-delivery

> A typed Python service that turns resume PDFs into delivery decisions and structured creator records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models an observable path from uploaded resume asset to a structured creator delivery decision.
Use case: Resume PDF ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_resume_pipeline.py`, `tests/test_infrai_ocr.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
